question: Why is the question asked by the great goddess considered difficult even for gods?
premises: The speaker expresses strong approval of the question.
The speaker has been asked by the great goddess.
The matter asked about is hard to obtain even for gods.
inference: The goddess has asked about a matter so profound that it is difficult even for the gods to obtain.
plain_english: Well said, well said, O great goddess! You have asked me about something that is hard for even the gods to obtain.
